summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Low-cost Android phones ship with residential proxy malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
